# Scholarly/Editorial Integrity Changelog

## 0.1.0 — 2026-08-13 — Initial package

- Added the governing Scholarly/Editorial Integrity specification copy.
- Added a 30-rule machine-readable registry for authority, preconditions, protected records, neutral signals, evidence, ownership, claim/source fit, quotation/paraphrase, source identity/status, overlap, authorship, disclosure, consistency, AI/confidentiality, routing, remedy, version lineage, reporting, and release.
- Added nine explicit MWM decision hooks for disclosure, material risk, ownership/referral, source-status, AI, retention, and public-remedy policy.
- Added source-access, claim, finding, decision, disclosure, contributor, AI-event, ledger, run, and cross-family contracts.
- Added 42 synthetic gold fixtures covering source fit, quotation, status, overlap, authorship, disclosures, internal contradictions, AI, serious concerns, and release gates.
- Added rule-to-fixture crosswalk, scorer, regression intake, and production-failure capture.

Status: draft-for-editorial-owner-review. No formal allegation or unresolved MWM integrity policy is silently generated by this package.

## 2026-08-14 packaging update

- Added `01_SPECIFICATION.docx` as a source-preserving Word version of the governing specification. The Markdown specification remains the design authority; no editorial rule or open MWM decision was changed.
